SELECT s.id, w.id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, l.id AS locationId, l.code AS locationCode, p.id AS partId, p.code AS partCode, p.name AS partName, p.unit AS unit, s.quantity, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM stock s JOIN location l ON l.id = s.location_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id JOIN part p ON p.id = s.part_id
AND l.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND s.location_id = #{q.locationId} AND s.part_id = #{q.partId}
AND (p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR l.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
